hypothesis: Starting-price cards with a WhatsApp CTA above the fold on mobile lift the price list's lead rate toward the site average, because visitors no longer scroll past the finder to reach a price and a button.
metric: lead persons / unique visitors on the page, mobile, 14 days post vs 14 days pre; secondary: whatsapp_click with cta=starting-card share

hypothesis: A three-step 'what happens next' list under the hero CTAs, a second price anchor (termite) and a line saying every service rate is further down give mobile visitors a reason to scroll and to tap WhatsApp, lifting homepage scroll depth and lead rate.
metric: homepage scroll_p50 and lead persons / unique visitors, mobile, 14 days post vs 14 days pre, tester ids excluded; secondary: whatsapp_click with cta=hero share

hypothesis: A price-led search message, populated starting prices and clear existing-home versus new-construction termite scope help buyers recognize the package and enquire. Evaluate as one combined package; overlapping starting-card work prevents an isolated title-test conclusion.
metric: Fixed Pakistan mobile pricing query group CTR, position and landing URL after 28 complete post-crawl days; secondary qualified organic enquiries and price-page lead persons / unique visitors. Extend low-volume observation to 6-8 weeks.

hypothesis: Distinct cleaning service pages with clear quotation requirements and contextual links help commercial buyers find the right scope and start an enquiry. This release adds homepage footer links and a commercial-page crosslink; existing money-page search titles and pricing copy are unchanged.
metric: Search Console impressions, clicks and query ownership for the new routes; WhatsApp and phone CTA activity by landing page. Qualified enquiries and won work must be confirmed separately from clicks. Record release date before evaluation.

hypothesis: A WhatsApp link inside the price FAQ answer on area pages converts the reader who opens the price question and leaves, because the tap is where the price is read instead of a scroll away.
metric: whatsapp_click with cta=faq on the three pages, and lead persons / unique visitors on them, 28 days post vs 28 days pre; secondary: faq_open on the price question followed by a lead event in the same session
